validated_invariants.reason: The exact policy, claim, operation, effect and original [retain_from_height, retain_until_height) window are passed to check_effects before open_budget, reserve or retention.reserve_until. Event simulation uses the original validators in a loaded in-memory snapshot, so a rejection at this preflight creates no new durable budget, claim or physical hold.

The independent Repair task and effect identity use the original custody window. Preflight occurs before the separate budget/claim reservation and is surrounded by the existing thread-CPU and absolute-wall checkpoints. The original mutation checks remain in place.

If the original effect exists, preflight requires exact policy/claim and operation/effect/window bindings, then returns Pending or Done without applying Event::Intent or decoding live funding for a new reservation. The service retains the original target-only reconcile paths; no new cache-bearing payload dispatch is granted. Completion bookkeeping may be reconciled, but the original cost reservation is not refunded.

The real native observer returns row=None when funding is absent after branch replacement. Exact existing effects bypass new-funding conversion while retaining network/parameters/genesis and owner-generation validation. A new intent still requires live funding. Existing reorg/restart controls inspect the original retained bytes with an empty source cache and unchanged charged report; these controls were read, not rerun by reviewer.

These recovery functions have no source/cache parameter and verify actual retained payload before reconciling completion metadata. Corruption or a missing target cannot authorize another initial copy or repair under the old effect.

The four new paths are unconditionally unioned before NATIVE_REQUIRED_PATHS is formed. check() requires their presence in required_paths, requires every required entry in pinned_blobs, and checks actual regular-file git-blob bytes. All four are linked from existing Rust test parents. HOLD and false activation/qualification flags are unchanged. This is source identity checking, not proof of test execution.
